Rahul Gandhi's Plea Faces Technical Issues in Court

Rahul Gandhi's legal petition has encountered 14 technical defects, including a blurred copy of Kharge's ID card and a shortfall in court fees. The court fee was Rs 200 or Rs 220 short, and the petition contained incomplete authorizations for nine petitioners. These issues have led to complications in the court's hearing of the plea.
